run_train_controlnet: run the ControlNet training script for Stable Diffusion XL with canny or depth conditioning using webdataset shards
create_dataset_webdataset: create a Text2ImageDataset with webdataset shards for training and evaluation with canny or depth control conditioning
test_filter_webdataset: test the WebdatasetFilter class to filter samples by minimum image size and watermark probability
review_encode_prompt: review the encode_prompt function that tokenizes captions with dual text encoders for SDXL
summarize_log_validation: summarize the log_validation function that runs inference and logs generated images to tensorboard or wandb
